en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih Al Sowry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the water in the container was a Kurr, nothing would pollute it’.
I said, ‘And how much (volume) is a Kurr?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Three and a half open palms width in depth by three and a half open palms width length/breadth (i.e. cubed)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from al-Hassan ibn Salih al-Thawriy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If a quantity of water measures one Kur it does not become unclean.’

I then asked, ‘How much is the quantity of Kur?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Three and a half shibr in depth and three and a half in width. ”’(A Shibr is from the tip of thumb to the tip of the small finger with the palm spread open)
